verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS sales-tax compliance product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. AutoFile and the nexus-tracking tool are rule-based automation features, not an AI assistant, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
